instruction.text: Matt measures his height and weight. Answer the questions below.

atoms.a: Matt measures himself as being 1.75 m tall. How tall is Matt in centimetres?
How tall is Matt to the nearest tenth of a metre.
Matt then weighs himself as being 70.86 kg. How much does Matt way in grams?
How much does Matt weigh to the nearest tenth of a kilogram.

instruction.text: Anna wants to see if a new cupboard will fit in her room. Answer the questions below.

atoms.a: The width of the cupboard measures 1.57 m. How wide is the cupboard in centimetres?
How wide is the cupboard to the nearest tenth of a metre?
The height of the cupboard measures 1.92 m. How tall is the cupboard in centimetres?
How tall is the cupboard to the nearest tenth of a metre?

instruction.text: Michael is baking a cake. Answer the questions below.

atoms.a: Michael weighs out 0.45 kg of sugar. What is the weight of the sugar in grams?
What is the weight of the sugar to the nearest tenth of a kilogram?
